title: DEMO (fictional): a phone-based coaching programme for adults with type 2 diabetes treated with metformin
lay_title: Demo trial (fictional): phone coaching for type 2 diabetes
lay_summary: A fictional study used only for this demonstration. It would test a phone-based coaching programme for adults with type 2 diabetes who take metformin. Taking part would mean one visit in central London and a monthly phone call.

criteria.lay_text: You are between 18 and 80 years old

criteria.text: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes at least 6 months ago
criteria.lay_text: You have had type 2 diabetes for at least six months

criteria.text: Myocardial infarction or stroke within the last 6 months
